args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks in all production regions after the latest deploy (error rate ~18%). Rolled back checkout-api in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. After rollback, service is healthy in all regions with error rate ~0.2%. Root cause of v2.3.1 failure still under investigation.
args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api on v2.3.1 was unhealthy across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an ~18% error rate. The most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back**: Rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all production regions.
3. **Verified**: The service is now healthy in all regions with the error rate down to ~0.2%.
4. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0") documenting the failure, the rollback, and the recovered state. The on-call engineer has been paged.

Note: the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure is still unknown — the incident is open for investigation.
